g.text: Automatically improves an AI agent by tuning its harness: the
prompt, model, tools, skills and settings around it.
Ready 1 run config · 1 eval the tuner can measure
These instructions guide the tuner when it plans new experiments. Some examples:
· Where to focus: "Start with the Correctness eval. It's our biggest quality gap."
· Trade-offs: "Between options of equal quality, prefer the cheaper one."
· Ideas to try: "Try the newest DeepSeek release on OpenRouter."
· What not to touch: "Don't change the model or temperature."
